title: jig worktree recipe (.claude/skills/worktree/recipe.json)
description: How this project makes worktrees: where, which modes, what to copy, share, regenerate or exclude, ports, env, setup, named commands and how to close. Written by /jig:worktree after the person approves it.

location.description: Folder for the worktrees, relative to the repo root or absolute. Default .claude/worktrees (where Claude Code's EnterWorktree works without an extra prompt).

branch_prefix.description: Prefix of each worktree's branch. Default wt/.

base.description: Branch a new worktree starts from: current (the main checkout's branch), trunk (jig.json trunk) or a branch name. Default current.

default_mode.description: auto (full if it fits on the disk with the margin, else trim heavy paths largest first), full, light (every heavy strategy applied) or an extra mode name. Default auto.

copy.description: Glob patterns of gitignored files every worktree gets (e.g. .env). Patterns in .worktreeinclude are added.

heavy.description: Paths that can fill the disk, with what to do when they are trimmed.

strategy.description: copy: copy it (copy-on-write when the filesystem supports it). share: link to the main checkout's copy (use read-only). regenerate: run command in the worktree. exclude: leave it out (sparse-checkout for tracked paths).

modes.description: Extra modes: light plus their own excludes. full, light and auto are built in.

disk_margin_percent.description: auto mode keeps at least this share of the volume free after creating the worktree. Default 15.

env_file.description: File in the worktree where the port variables are written (other lines are kept).

range.description: Ports to pick from (stable per worktree name). Default [10000, 19999].

env.description: Variables exported by `jig worktree run`. Placeholders: {{name}}, {{branch}}, {{path}}, {{repo_root}}, {{repo_parent}}, {{port}}.

setup.description: Commands the agent runs in a new worktree with `jig worktree run <name> setup`.

commands.description: Named project steps run with `jig worktree run <name> <command>`. pre-finish runs before finish integrates.

dirty_base_paths_ok.description: Uncommitted paths in the base checkout that do not stop finish (e.g. .okf/ edited by another session).

reminder_every.description: Remind the active worktrees every N prompts (0: only when they change). Default 5.

caches.description: Planned (phase 2): shared read-only caches per version.

slots.description: Planned (phase 2): concurrency slots for heavy commands.
